slots_and_copies.name: trailer
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Global trailer: 16B magic + 12B padding/variable + 4B checksum; not a slot

checksums.name: global_sum32
checksums.formula_detail: u32 accumulator = sum of unsigned bytes over [0,0x341C); stored as u32 LE at 0x341C (last 4 bytes of the 0x3420-byte image). Writer sums total-4 bytes, reader sums 0x341C bytes and compares to the following int32

io_driver_functions.notes: Save loader/validator: SRAM-read via 0x089feaa8 thunk, 4-word magic compare, sum32 verify, dispatch on success; on failure DMA-restores default buffer, calls writer 0x086d5bf8, sets state 0x03000002=0x1c. No caller in callgraph.json (indirect/state-machine entry)

Save writer: sum8 over total-4 bytes, stores u32 at last 4 bytes, SRAM-write via 0x089feab4 thunk to 0x0E000000; sets 0x030002b3=0xFF on write error. Also reachable from loader failure path; other callers via unrecovered jumptables
Unrecovered jumptable thunk used as SRAM read (src=0x0E000000, dst=RAM buffer, len). Body not in decompiled set
Unrecovered jumptable thunk used as SRAM write (src=RAM buffer, dst=0x0E000000, len, end-ptr); returns status checked by writer
RULED OUT: DMA3 (0x040000D4) tile/VRAM streamer to 0x0600E000, not save I/O
RULED OUT: DMA3 chunk copy to IWRAM 0x03000A00 (palette/work RAM), not save I/O
